_comment: One-time capture from the public Stellar testnet Soroban RPC (https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org), used as immutable fixture data by the mocked RPC in tests/e2e/sorobanRpcMock.ts. The header/metadata XDR only has to parse as real XDR — the mock never interprets it — and the account entry supplies a real sequence number for the fixed mock admin wallet.
